claim_scope: 5000-image (2500-frame) OpenLORIS corridor1-1 tier, GT-free candidate generation/matching/admission; ground truth used only for the post-map score in stage f. This is a follow-on to m9-openloris-sparse-stereo-rank0-prefix-5000-v1: it targets exactly the 46 frames that remained unregistered under rank 1 after that experiment.
background: The stride-8 sparse-stereo experiment (m9-openloris-sparse-stereo-rank0-prefix-5000-v1) registered rank 0 (1933 frames, byte-invariant) and rank 1 (521/567 supplied frames), leaving rank 1's own unregistered_below_sensors set at 46 frames: {1931} union {1934..1977} union {1979} minus frame 1978 (1978 is already registered by rank 1). Of that 46-frame set, 7 frames were already probed as stride-8 anchors in the prior experiment (1931, 1934, 1942, 1950, 1958, 1966, 1974) -- 4 of those 7 (1942, 1950, 1958, 1974) never produced an accepted stereo pair and stayed unregistered; the other 3 (1931, 1934, 1966) had accepted stereo pairs but were still NOT registered by any exported model (they are part of the 46-frame set). This experiment ("gap46") targets the 39 not-yet-tried frames in the 46-frame set with a dense (gap=0) synchronized-stereo probe, to see how much of the remaining gap a denser GT-free stereo pass can close without perturbing rank 0 or rank 1.

target_derivation.rank1_unregistered_frame_set_46_derivati: base-unregistered set {1931} union {1934..2499} (567 frames) minus rank 1's own registered_frames (521), computed by parsing component-001/images.txt from either the frozen stereo8 run or this gap46 run (rank 1 is byte-identical between the two, see gate G3)
target_derivation.excluded_already_tried_frames_7_reason: these are exactly the stride-8 anchor frames from m9-openloris-sparse-stereo-rank0-prefix-5000-v1 that fall inside the 46-frame gap; probing them again with the same dense-stereo method would not be a new test
target_derivation.target_frames_39_check: 46 - 7 = 39, and candidates.txt's own embedded metadata target_frames line matches this list exactly (verified by direct parse)
target_derivation.stride8_anchor_failure_detail: 4 of the 7 already-tried stride-8 anchors (1942, 1950, 1958, 1974) never produced an accepted stereo pair in the prior experiment; the other 3 (1931, 1934, 1966) had accepted stereo pairs but were still unregistered. All 7 are excluded because re-matching the same pair is deterministic and would not add evidence.

gates_declared_before_running.G3: rank 1 (component-001 cameras.txt/images.txt/points3D.txt) must stay byte-identical (sha256) to the prior stride-8 experiment's rank 1, and its GT RMSE/p95 must be unchanged

stage_g_matches_import_exporter.purpose: close the provenance gap left by the prior stride-8 experiment's report, which reconstructed matches-import.txt ad hoc by shelling out to inspect_verified_pair_snapshot --pair-matches per pair with a one-off script
stage_g_matches_import_exporter.tool_description: argparse CLI; takes --candidate-manifest (image-name preamble), --snapshot (a verified .vps to read pairs/correspondences from via the inspect_verified_pair_snapshot binary), --inspect-binary, --output; deterministic (subprocess calls only read a frozen snapshot file, no randomness)
stage_g_matches_import_exporter.unit_tests: scripts/tests/test_export_verified_matches_import.py (8 tests: parse_pairs_tsv, parse_images_tsv, parse_pair_matches, build_matches_import_lines) -- all pass
stage_g_matches_import_exporter.key_finding: matches-import.txt (the raw-match input to the frozen ratio-0.8 reverify stage) is reconstructed from the earlier, LOOSER ratio-0.95 stage-b snapshot (mapping/verified-merged.vps), not from the final ratio-0.8 verified.vps -- this also explains why the pairs.tsv/images.tsv files sitting in each *-sift-reverify-v1 directory are byte-identical to inspect_verified_pair_snapshot's output on the stage-b snapshot, not the stage-c one (verified independently for the stereo8 baseline before writing the exporter)

repeat_determinism.interpretation: run-to-run wall-clock/allocator noise only, not a determinism break -- consistent with the same finding in the prior stride-8 experiment's own repeat run

diagnosis_of_remaining_16_frames.method: read feature_count directly from images.tsv (via inspect_verified_pair_snapshot --images-tsv) for cam1/cam2 frames 1920-1979 (the whole neighborhood around the gap); cross-referenced stage-c's 13-accepted/39-candidate result against the FULL pre-gap46 base pair graph (31590 pairs, dumped via inspect_verified_pair_snapshot --pairs-tsv on base-plus-stereo.vps) to find frames with literally zero verified edges to anything, not just within this probe's 39-candidate window

feature_starvation.note: roughly 27-32 features/image through the gap region, well below the hundreds of features typical elsewhere in this tier -- SIFT keypoint yield is low here, which caps how many candidate pairs can even reach min_matches=12 after ratio filtering

zero_edges_in_full_base_pair_graph_befor.note: these 5 frames had NO verified stereo edge to ANY other frame anywhere in the pre-gap46 31590-pair graph (not just within this probe's 39-candidate window) -- the strongest available evidence of feature starvation rather than a geometry/bridging-radius limitation. Two of them (1956, 1962) did gain their first-ever accepted edge from this gap46 probe itself but still failed to register in the mapper (see next bucket).

targeted_in_this_probe_but_rejected.note: these 9 of the 39 gap46 candidates did not pass the ratio-0.95/ratio-0.8 verification thresholds (below min_matches=12 or failed geometric verification)

accepted_pair_but_still_failed_to_regist.note: these 4 frames DID get an accepted, re-verified stereo pair in this experiment (part of the 13-pair accepted set) but the mapper still could not register them -- most likely below min-pnp-sensors=2 or insufficient triangulated landmark support given only their single new edge and no additional bridging neighbors

not_targeted_in_this_probe.note: 3 of the 7 already-tried stride-8 anchors (see stride8_anchor_failure_detail) that failed to get an accepted pair back in the original stride-8 experiment and were deliberately excluded from this probe's target list; they remain untested by any dense stereo probe

breakdown_of_the_16_still_unregistered.count_check: 5 (zero-edge, of which 2 overlap with the accepted-but-unregistered bucket) + 9 (rejected-in-probe) + 4 (accepted-but-unregistered) + 3 (not-targeted) = 16, with 1956 and 1962 counted once each in zero-edges and once in accepted-but-unregistered since both facts are true of them

diagnosis_of_remaining_16_frames.conclusion: the remaining 16-frame gap is predominantly feature-starved, not policy-limited: 5 of the 16 frames had zero verified stereo edges anywhere before this experiment, and mean feature counts through the whole 1920-1979 neighborhood are roughly 27-32/image. Closing more of this gap would need denser feature extraction (e.g. a lower SIFT contrast threshold or a different detector) for this specific stretch of the corridor sequence, not further matcher-ratio or bridging-radius tuning -- and any such change must not be tuned against ground truth.

implementation.rank0_pair_prefix_flag_status: already committed to examples/generalized_rig_sfm.rs (commit 7ebc0ff), not uncommitted as the prior report noted -- verified via git log

decision.summary: This gap46 arm is recorded as a registration diagnostic step, not a benchmark result. It closes 30 of the 46-frame rank-1 gap by admitting a dense (gap=0) GT-free stereo probe over the 39 not-yet-tried frames, re-verified under the same frozen ratio-0.8 policy, merged after the existing 31590-pair prefix, and mapped with the same --rank0-pair-prefix guard. Rank 0 and rank 1 are provably unperturbed (byte-identical model files, identical GT RMSE/p95). The 30 recovered frames form component-003, a separate, independently Sim(3)-fitted 30-frame component that is NOT joined to rank 0 or rank 1 -- its low per-component RMSE (0.0314 m) and p95 (0.0606 m) reflect that small independent gauge, not a general accuracy improvement, and must not be quoted as an accuracy claim against rank 0/rank 1's numbers. mapper_seconds increases ~21.9% vs the stride8 baseline (148.98s -> 181.53s); this is reported for transparency but is not a gated metric. The 5000-image tier remains a development tier: no COLMAP-parity or README claim is made, and no promotion to docs/readme_details.md or the benchmark registry is performed.
decision.not_claimed: COLMAP parity, wall-clock/performance superiority, held-out generalization beyond the 5k development tier, or that component-003's RMSE is representative of rank 0/rank 1 accuracy
decision.next: the remaining 16 frames are feature-starved (mean ~27-32 features/image in the 1920-1979 neighborhood; 5 of the 16 have zero verified stereo edges at all in this probe) rather than limited by matcher/mapper policy. Closing this residual gap would require denser feature extraction (e.g. lower SIFT contrast threshold or a different detector) specifically over this stretch, not further threshold tuning -- and per standing policy, ground truth must not be used to select or tune any such change, only for post-hoc scoring as done here.
